findings.claim: FY2026 前三大批發客戶約占總淨營收 11%（約 70% 屬北美、30% 屬歐洲）；占應收帳款毛額約 29%（2026-03-28）。
findings.excerpt: Sales to our three largest wholesale customers accounted for approximately 11% of total net revenues for Fiscal 2026, and these customers accounted for approximately 29% of our total gross trade accounts receivable outstanding as of March 28, 2026.

findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 財報附註
findings.excerpt: For the Company's wholesale business, concentration of credit risk is relatively limited due to the large number of customers and their dispersion across many geographic areas.
